chunk_61.content:
export async function getDocumentWithStats(
  supabase: Client,
  slug: string
): Promise<DocumentWithStats | null> {
  // Get the document first (need the ID for other queries)
  const document = await getDocumentBySlug(supabase, slug)
  if (!document) return null

  // Run all stat queries in parallel
  const [
    { count: sectionsCount },
    { count: approvedCount },
    { data: sections },
  ] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from("document_sections")
      .select("*", { count: "exact", head: true })
      .eq("document_id", document.id),
    supabase
      .from("document_sections")
      .select("*", { count: "exact", head: true })
      .eq("document_id", document.id)
      .eq("status", "approved"),
    supabase
      .from("document_sections")
      .select("id")
      .eq("document_id", document.id),
  ])

  const sectionIds = (sections || []).map((s) => s.id)

  // Get comments and edits counts in parallel
  let commentsCount = 0
  let editsCount = 0

  if (sectionIds.length > 0) {
    const [{ count: comments }, { count: edits }] = await Promise.all([
      supabase
        .from("comments")
        .select("*", { count: "exact", head: true })
        .in("section_id", sectionIds),
      supabase
        .from("edits")
        .select("*", { count: "exact", head: true })
        .in("section_id", sectionIds),
    ])
    commentsCount = comments || 0
    editsCount = edits || 0
  }

  const total = sectionsCount || 0
  const approved = approvedCount || 0
  const progressPercentage = total > 0 ? Math.round((approved / total) * 100) : 0

  return {
    ...document,
    sections_count: total,
    approved_count: approved,
    comments_count: commentsCount,
    edits_count: editsCount,
    progress_percentage: progressPercentage,
  }
}
